name: Tomigusuku (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tomigusuku city emblem in white: three interlocking curved segments with rings, like a triskele.
history: Municipal flag of Tomigusuku, a city in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 2002; the emblem dates from 1 April 1976.

features.role: Tomigusuku city emblem — three interlocking curved segments with rings, like a triskele
